Method of Attack: Encrypts users' devices and only decrypts them if victims join the developer's Discord server
Launches DECRYPT-MY-FILES.exe decryptor that prompts victims to enter their Discord user token
Uses Discord token to authenticate and check if victim joined Discord server to allow decryption
If victim joined or server does not exist, decrypts files using static key embedded in ransomware
Attack Vector: Execution of encryptor component found on VirusTotal
